reviewSummary: CONSENT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Subject custody held at 4db52163 and mode 0444 across the whole review. All 11 dispatch attacks and 22 further attacks of this review's own were refuted against live bytes. All 9 digest assertions in the draft and all 93 recordedInputs digests in the frozen successor were recomputed from disk with zero mismatches, and all 15 identifier-shaped tokens resolved to the artifacts that define them. Both Stage A return shapes were enumerated key by key and every presence and absence the draft asserts is correct in both directions, including the absent decision fields, the seven-member advisory shape, and the two Codex counts being JSON numbers; the object/string split is attributed to the right reviewer at all four sites. The substantive act is real rather than restated: fixtures/g19.v2/ holds exactly 48 files in four platform directories, each byte-identical under diff -r to the twelve fixtures/g19.v1/ implementations D-299 authored, and the catalog's 12 members carry 48 platform-copy references, so 'forty-eight copies of the twelve D-299 implementations' is exact in both numbers. Platforms are quoted rather than invented and are ORDERED-EQUAL across G19, G10 and G23 occupancy v2, with no Windows directory on disk. The leftover position is measured, not asserted: OBL-G19-FX-AUTHORING reads leftoverDesign true on both g19 leftover-join.v6 and state-class leftover-join.v4, OBL-GRANT-JOURNAL, OBL-INHERIT-BLOCKED and OBL-MONOTONIC stay on v4, and the successor's leftoverDesignClosedIfAcceptedAndRecorded is empty. The draft leaves the staleness of the forty-eight copies to a later g19 leftover-join remasurement exactly as ADOPTED D-327 did for the forty G20 copies. HEAD, last heading D-330, required-now 28, condition 2 at 5 of 32, condition 4 at 28 of 28, the COORD digest and the file 08 digest all re-derive, no tracked file is modified in the working tree, and the no-cell-edit branch correctly excludes D-236 as the only SATISFIED-titled heading in D-170..D-330. Four observations are recorded at severity none with no change requested.
